svg.aria-label: NOV 6 X01 MAP: In the app on day one, updated as we learn more. NOV 7 BUILD YOUR OWN: Make your own weapon builds, attachment by attachment. NOV 10 MACOS: Work on the Mac app starts. LATER MOBILE AND WEB: Android, iOS, a website and one account everywhere. ALWAYS: Optimisation · small fixes · more compact controls · UI updates. Dates are the plan. If the game changes, the plan changes with it.
